description: Check the text of a Shopify Inventory CSV (it holds HS Code and COO, country of origin) or product CSV for missing or malformed HS codes, countries of origin, item identifiers (SKU or barcode) and invalid barcodes. Use it for "which products have no HS code?", "is my export ready for customs?". Pass the csv text exactly as exported, up to 2 MB. Returns counts (null where the file has no such column), up to 200 rows with the problem on each, and notes on columns the file lacks. Nothing is stored: the input is used for this answer and dropped.

csv.description: The CSV text exactly as exported from Shopify, header row included. At most 2 MB.

name: customs_data_gap_check

summary.description: A count is null when the file has no column to check it with.

title: Check a Shopify CSV for customs data gaps
